title: Joby Aviation, Inc. 8-K Filing — Departure of Named Executive Officer
summary: Joby Aviation, Inc. filed an 8-K on April 20, 2026 disclosing that Didier Papadapoulos, President of Aircraft OEM, will resign effective July 3, 2026 to spend time with family and pursue personal interests. The company stated the resignation is not related to any disagreement or dispute. Mr. Papadapoulos will provide ongoing advisory services to the company.
key_points: Reason cited: family and personal interests, not disagreement or dispute
Five years of service leading aircraft development efforts
Company expects to enter into advisory services agreement with departing executive
Signed by CFO Rodrigo Brumana on April 21, 2026
why_it_matters: This is a routine corporate governance disclosure. Executive departures at early-stage aerospace companies can signal strategic shifts or operational challenges, though the company explicitly denies any negative context. Not relevant to macro market analysis.
